
// 1) Actual 개월 수 (예: "3+9" -> 3)
IF
    CASE [Month]
        WHEN "Jan" THEN 1
        WHEN "Feb" THEN 2
        WHEN "Mar" THEN 3
        WHEN "Apr" THEN 4
        WHEN "May" THEN 5
        WHEN "Jun" THEN 6
        WHEN "Jul" THEN 7
        WHEN "Aug" THEN 8
        WHEN "Sep" THEN 9
        WHEN "Oct" THEN 10
        WHEN "Nov" THEN 11
        WHEN "Dec" THEN 12
        ELSE NULL
    END
    <= INT(SPLIT([Title Suffix], "+", 1))
THEN "Actual"
ELSE "Forecast"
END
